mapper.select: select 'XWXT' as systemCode, -- 来源系统 CASE WHEN gf.vc_chuzrwtdlr='海通恒信国际融资租赁股份有限公司' THEN '01-C0001' WHEN gf.vc_chuzrwtdlr='海通恒信国际融资租赁（天津）有限公司' THEN '02-C0001' WHEN gf.vc_chuzrwtdlr='海通恒信小微融资租赁（上海）有限公司' THEN '80001' WHEN gf.vc_chuzrwtdlr='海通恒运融资租赁（上海）有限公司' THEN '30001' END AS orgId, -- gf.vc_chuzrwtdlr 签约主体名称, ht.vc_hetbh as contractCode, -- 合同编号 -- ht.vc_hetmc 合同名称, ht.vc_kehbh as clientCode, -- 客户编号 -- czr.vc_kehmc 客户名称, cw.nu_qix as periods, -- 期数 -- ht.dt_shijqzr 业务日期, max(nvl(zjjh.dt_chengfrq,cw.dt_chengfrq)) as planDate, -- 计划还款日 sum(nvl(zjjh.dec_zuj,0)) as rentAmount, -- "归还租金（含税额）" sum(nvl(zjjh.dec_benj,0)) as principalAmount , -- "归还本金（含税额）" sum(nvl(zjjh.dec_zux,0)) as interestAmount, -- "归还利息（含税额）" -- nvl(zjjh.dec_zuj,0) "归还租金（不含税额）", -- nvl(zjjh.dec_benj,0) "归还本金（不含税额）", -- nvl(zjjh.dec_zux,0) "归还利息（不含税额）", hlzt.vc_mingc as recaptureStatus , -- 回笼状态 zjjh.dec_nianll as sourceIrrRate, -- decode(nvl(zjjh.vc_jihzt,'0'), '0', 0, trunc(sysdate) - zjjh.dt_chengfrq) 逾期天数, sum(cw.dec_jingll) as cashFlow from jbfs.bz_hetjbxx ht join jbfs.bz_hetgf gf on gf.vc_hetbh = ht.vc_hetbh join jbfs.cm_jigkh czr on czr.vc_kehbh = ht.vc_kehbh join jbfs.fm_jiaoyjg jg on jg.vc_cesztbh = ht.vc_hetbh left join jbfs.fm_jiaoyjgcwxjl cw on jg.vc_cesztbh = cw.vc_cesztbh left join jbfs.fm_jiaoyjgzjjh zjjh on zjjh.vc_cesztbh = cw.vc_cesztbh and zjjh.nu_qix = cw.nu_duiyzjbdqx left join jbfs.ba_shujzd hlzt on hlzt.vc_zhi = zjjh.vc_jihzt and hlzt.vc_fujdid = 'huilzt' where ht.vc_hetzt = '31' group by gf.vc_chuzr, ht.vc_hetbh, ht.vc_kehbh, cw.nu_qix, nvl(zjjh.dt_chengfrq,cw.dt_chengfrq), hlzt.vc_mingc, zjjh.dec_nianll order by ht.vc_hetbh, nvl(zjjh.dt_chengfrq,cw.dt_chengfrq)

WITH table1 AS ( SELECT CONTRACT_ID FROM jbfs.rpt_accmonth_firr_new GROUP BY contract_id HAVING TRUNC(max(PLAN_DATE)) >= TRUNC(TO_DATE('2023-01-01', 'YYYY-MM-DD')) ) select 'XWXT' as systemCode, s.vc_hetbh AS contractCode, s.nu_jihqx AS periods, s.vc_wangybh AS ebankSerialNumber, trunc(s.dt_huilrq) AS planDate, s.dec_huilzj AS actualRepaymentRentAmount, s.dec_huilbj AS actualRepaymentPrincipalAmount, s.dec_huilzx AS actualRepaymentInteresAmount -- s.dec_huilfx 已收罚息, -- s.dec_faxtz 罚息调整, -- s.vc_fukr 付款人, -- d1.vc_mingc 结算方式, -- d2.vc_mingc 是否代付, -- trunc(s.dt_shurrq) 操作日期 from jbfs.fm_zujhl s inner join table1 d on s.vc_hetbh = d.contract_id left join jbfs.ba_shujzd d1 on d1.vc_zhi = s.vc_jiesfs left join jbfs.ba_shujzd d2 on d2.vc_zhi = s.vc_shifdf and d2.vc_fujdid = 'flag'
and s.vc_hetbh = #{params.contractCode}

SELECT shifyzwzsk.vc_mingc AS isTransferTemporaryCredit, a.vc_wangybh AS ebankSerialNumber, a.vc_daozyh AS collectionAccountsBankName, a.vc_fukkh AS paymentClientName, a.dt_daozsj AS businessDate, a.dec_daozje AS ebankAmount, nvl(x.t1, 0) + nvl(y.t2, 0) AS confirmedAmount, a.dec_daozje - nvl(x.t1, 0) - nvl(y.t2, 0) AS nonConfirmedAmount, a.vc_zhaiy AS remark, a.vc_suosgs AS collectionAccountsBankOrgName FROM jbfs.fm_wangysj a LEFT JOIN ( SELECT vc_wangybh, SUM(nvl(dec_huilzj, 0) + nvl(dec_huilfx, 0) + nvl(dec_huandje, 0)) t1 FROM jbfs.fm_zujhl WHERE nvl(dt_huijclr, dt_huilrq) < to_date(#{params.queryDate}, 'yyyy/mm/dd') + 1 GROUP BY vc_wangybh ) x ON a.vc_wangybh = x.vc_wangybh LEFT JOIN ( SELECT vc_wangybh, SUM(nvl(dec_shouzje, 0)) t2 FROM jbfs.fm_shissf WHERE nvl(dt_huijclr, dt_shouzrq) < to_date(#{params.queryDate}, 'yyyy/mm/dd') + 1 GROUP BY vc_wangybh ) y ON a.vc_wangybh = y.vc_wangybh LEFT JOIN jbfs.ba_shujzd shifyzwzsk ON shifyzwzsk.vc_zhi = a.ch_shifyzwzsk AND shifyzwzsk.vc_fujdid = 'flag' LEFT JOIN jbfs.inter_orgcode inter_orgcode ON inter_orgcode.org_name = a.vc_suosgs WHERE a.dt_shangcrq < to_date(#{params.queryDate}, 'yyyy/mm/dd') + 1 AND a.ch_youxbs = '0' AND a.ch_zulxgbz = '0' AND a.dec_daozje - nvl(x.t1, 0) - nvl(y.t2, 0) <> 0 AND a.vc_wangybh NOT IN ('03A151023023606', '03A160620012145')
